g.text: KESTREL K1 — KA-110P hip-roll output flange (Mk II)
Tolerances: 12x M5 6H (HeliCoil) on PCD 100 ±0.02; 2x Ø5 H7 dowels; faces flat 0.01 · Finish: hard anodise black
Dimension from the STEP model; general tolerances per docs/09 §2. Break sharp edges 0.2–0.5 mm. Projection: isometric, hidden lines grey.
